author: K. C. Ritchie
title: GoKnights shares sports update and recruitment call on March 25
text:
Arthur-Lovington/Atwood-Hammond High School’s official Twitter account, #GoKnights, posted several updates on March 25, 2026, including announcements about athletics and recruitment.
On the morning of March 25, the school highlighted a sporting event with the post: “Softball @ Shelbyville https://t.co/G1PRwaPYRD” (posted at 11:00 UTC). Later that day, another tweet was published: “Announcements: Wednesday, March 25, 2026 https://t.co/5kGv9MBNqr https://t.co/KRaZ6LZgbu” (15:40 UTC). In the afternoon, a further message encouraged participation in the school community: “Join our Team at AHGS! https://t.co/uoRQCkL8wn” (17:23 UTC).
Arthur-Lovington/Atwood-Hammond High School is located in Arthur within Douglas County and serves grades nine through twelve. During the 2019-2020 academic year, it enrolled 328 students. According to state data from the Illinois Report Card, ninth graders made up the largest group at the school—39 percent of total enrollment—while grade ten accounted for 28.6 percent, grade eleven for 26.4 percent, and grade twelve for 27.9 percent (source). The student body during that year was predominantly white at 94.5 percent; black students comprised 1.5 percent, Hispanic students represented 2.7 percent, and Asian students made up 0.3 percent (Illinois Report Card).
The recent posts from #GoKnights reflect ongoing engagement with both current and prospective members of their school community.
